messages:
Marta (CSM): Heads-up — EBR in 5 days for Acme Corp. Need a tight prep thread: slide owners, demo owner, onboarding status snapshot, any renewal risks, and executive asks. Can folks drop short bullets here by EOD?
Jordan (Product): I can own the product roadmap slide — will pull 30s talking points and 2 screenshots. Link to deck: https://docs.google.com/example (will update).
Lenora (Solutions): I’ll run the live demo. Plan: 8-min walkthrough of inference latency improvements + 2-min Q&A. Need a stable test key and sample dataset from Acme — @Evan can you confirm dataset and test account?
Evan (Customer): Confirmed — dataset is the 'catalog-v2' bucket, test account evan_acme@acme. Need SSO enabled for our execs; is there an ETA?
Priya (Onboarding): Onboarding status: completed infra checklist, data ingest 85% done, two outstanding items: SSO mapping and RBAC for analytics. Estimated finish: 48–72 hours if SSO config provided today.
Amir (CS Dir): Flagging renewal risk: ACV at 9 months, exec sponsor change last week. Not urgent but want to surface in EBR (ask: executive alignment and renewal path). Recommend 1-slide summary of risks + mitigation plan.
Marta (CSM): Noted. Action items so far: 1) Jordan — product slide + short bullets (due tomorrow noon). 2) Lenora — demo runbook + sample commands (due in 24h). 3) Priya — SSO/RBAC status + block list. 4) Amir — risk slide draft. 5) Evan — confirm test creds and whether execs want a private pre-brief.
Lenora (Solutions): Demo runbook snippet (will paste into doc):
```
# Demo runbook (condensed)
1) Use test key: evan_demo_key (temp)
2) Run: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"catalog latency check"}'
3) Validate: avg latency < 120ms for cold start
```
Jordan (Product): For the deck, I’ll include two charts: cost-per-token trend (last 30d) and 95th pct latency. Anyone have objections to including the cost chart?
Priya (Onboarding): Cost chart fine. Also adding one onboarding metric slide: ingest % / eval pass rate / open blockers.
Evan (Customer): Execs would appreciate a 10 minute pre-brief the day before (just 2 PM their timezone). Can we schedule?
Marta (CSM): Yes — I’ll create a 30-min pre-brief slot. @deploy-bot can you create the calendar event and invite Acme execs + our leads?
deploy-bot: Event created: Acme EBR pre-brief — 2024-06-14 14:00 UTC. Calendar invites sent to evan_acme@acme and internal owners.
Amir (CS Dir): One more ask — attach a short appendix showing SLA history for last quarter (uptime, incident count, MTTR). That will help the new sponsor.
Lenora (Solutions): Copy that — I’ll pull incident timeline and have a 1-slide appendix.
Marta (CSM): Great. Quick checklist update: Jordan (product slide) ✅ in progress; Lenora (demo runbook) ✅ in progress; Priya (SSO/RBAC) — please escalate to infra if blocked; Amir (risk slide) — draft due EOD tomorrow; Evan — confirm whether execs want any specific themes.
Evan (Customer): They want emphasis on reliability and cost predictability. Also can you add a short ROI example for their largest use-case?
Jordan (Product): Will add a 1-slide ROI example (2 bullets + one calc).
Priya (Onboarding): SSO vendor is Okta — sending metadata now. If we get it in the next 2 hours, I can finish mapping today.
Marta (CSM): Perfect. Final ask: everyone paste their short bullets into the shared deck notes section (not the slide) so we can rehearse. Link again: https://docs.google.com/example. Rehearsal slot tomorrow 11:30 UTC.
Amir (CS Dir): Rehearsal confirmed from my side.
Marta (CSM): Thanks all — closing thread. I’ll post run-of-show once we have final slides. :thumbsup:
